title: AITA For not wanting my girlfriend to get coffee alone with a thirsty guy?
question: AITA For not wanting my girlfriend to get coffee alone with a thirsty guy?
body: There’s a little backstory to this one so please bear with me. A few months ago I was out with my girlfriend, her brother and, and her roommate having a picnic on my college campus. We are kicking a soccer ball around and some guy walks up to us and asks if he can join in - sure, no problem. The more he talks, the weirder he gets. He starts to brag about how he’s “been intimate” with 14 women since he got here earlier in the year (which he later defines as kissing) and is obviously interested in my gf and her roommate. He also tells us how he’s disappointed that America isn’t like it is in the movies where all the girls want to sleep with you all the time. Apart from the weird comments he’s also generally socially awkward. When we finally decide that it’s time to leave my girlfriend asks for his phone number and we all part ways. I asked her why she got his number and she said that she felt bad for him because he just seemed really lonely and he’s in a new place all by himself so he probably doesn’t have any friends. I feel the need to say here that I trust her and I don’t think she’d ever cheat on me, she can just be very niave/oblivious at times. After a week or so the now five of us get lunch on campus together (just as awkward but I’ll spare you the reading) and pretty much stop having contact with him after that other than him making a few more attempts to make plans with us by texting my gf and a happy New Years text followed up by another request to make more plans that ended up in limbo as well. Well today, months later, my gf texted me saying that she’s getting coffee with him alone. I’m pretty upset by this because we’ve talked about how she doesn’t realize some guys take being friendly as flirty (and she’s a very friendly person) and specifically about how this guy seems really desperate. She says there’s nothing wrong with it because it’s “obviously not a date” but I’m still pretty upset. AITA or am I being too up tight about this?
